exec: pm.test("Seed page", () => { const p=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.content.length).to.eql(3); pm.expect(p.totalElements).to.eql(3); pm.expect(p.size).to.eql(10); });

pm.test("Same ID and updated fields", () => { const c=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(c.categoryId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("categoryId"))); pm.expect(c.categoryName).to.eql("Academic & Research News"); pm.expect(c.parentCategoryId).to.eql(2); pm.expect(c.active).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("Business rule", () => { const e=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(e.code).to.eql("CONFLICT"); pm.expect(e.message).to.include("news articles"); });

pm.test("Bounded second page", () => { const p=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.content).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(p.number).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.size).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.totalElements).to.eql(3); pm.expect(p.content[0].categoryName).to.eql("Campus Safety"); });

pm.test("Minimal seed article", () => { const p=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(p.content).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(p.content[0].newsArticleId).to.eql("S22-SEED-001"); pm.expect(p.content[0].categoryId).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("ID retained, FK changed", () => { const a=pm.response.json(); pm.expect(a.newsArticleId).to.eql("S22-TEMP-001"); pm.expect(a.categoryId).to.eql(3); });
